reset: Delete synthetic records between version-batches, retain indexes. Keep database during application-restart trials.
order: Alternate baseline/recovery by condition index plus batch or trial number.
oracle: Prewritten intended-purchase IDs, fixed fixture prices and quantities; server attempt labels are observations only.
observation: Inspect stored records once all attempts settle; wait to the fixed deadline for purchases with no acknowledged order. Every failed/timeout attempt remains in raw logs.
scope: Local single-host synthetic workloads, not production capacity or restaurant demand. Baseline and recovery share pricing and ownership. Whole combined design is compared.
pilotDecision: Keep 20 x 20 API workload and 5 paired browser trials per condition. API overlap and commit-before-drop confirmed. Browser harness starts the first tab before opening the second and explicitly activates tabs. No measured data collected before freeze.
